A Production Possibility Frontier (PPF) graph. The vertical Y-axis is going from 0 to 110. The horizontal X-axis is going from 0 to 50. A thick, concave (bowed-out) curve connects points A(0, 100), B(10, 90), C(20, 70), D(30, 40), and E(40, 0). A point labeled 'U' (representing Unemployment/Inefficiency) is drawn inside the curve beneath the arch. A point labeled 'F' (representing Unattainable) is drawn completely outside the curve to the top right. A dotted line shows a second curve shifted entirely to the right (outward),. Style: clean flat textbook illustration, crisp black lines, white background, distinct dots for points.
